```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("R/parse_europasscv.R")
cv_tex <- "cv_source/CV_Andrea_Vaiano_no_dati.tex"

# Sections present in the .tex but not shown here, because they have their own page.
# To bring one back, delete it from this vector — nothing else needs changing. To hide
# another, add its \ecvsection name exactly as written in the .tex.
skip_sections <- c("Conferences and Seminars")

sections <- parse_europasscv(cv_tex)
sections <- Filter(function(s) !(s$name %in% skip_sections), sections)
```

This page is generated from `` `r cv_tex` `` — the same LaTeX source as the PDF. To update
it, edit the `.tex` and re-render the site. Conferences and seminars have their own
[page](talks/conferences.qmd).

[Download PDF](cv.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm role="button"}

```{r}
#| label: cv-body

cat(render_cv_sections(sections))
```
